newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down seven cents to 14.28 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down seven cents to 14.28 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell seven cents to 14.28 ringgit ($5.71) a kg, after following a decline in overnight values on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was a lot of selling after the LME's fall," said a trader. The London market closed $25 down on Wednesday.
Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.
Initial offers of 133 tonnes outplaced bids for 53 tonnes. Turnover fell to 101 tonnes from 130 on Wednesday. The local premium over the LME narrowed to $55 from $70 previously.
